## Welcome

This standalone site contains the Kaikoria Valley College Urban Farm units 2026. The units are designed to be used in the context of the school farm, providing students with practical applications of agriculture and horticulture while exploring mathematical concepts through real-world scenarios.

## Course Overview



### Units

This course aligns with the Refreshed New Zealand Curriculum (2026) and is designed to provide students with practical applications of agriculture and horticulture in the context of our school farm. Each unit focuses on a specific aspect of farm operations, allowing students to real and develop new skills at the same time as they explore mathematical concepts through real-world scenarios.
